title: Stage Course Enrollment Capacity Metrics
description_markdown: From `courses` and `enrollments`, calculate for each course: `c.course_code`, `c.course_name`, count of active enrollments (`COUNT(e.enrollment_id)` as `enrolled_students`). Order by `enrolled_students` DESC, `c.course_id` ASC.
starter_query:
-- Course enrollment capacity staging
SELECT ...
solution_query: SELECT c.course_code, c.course_name, COUNT(e.enrollment_id) AS enrolled_students FROM courses c LEFT JOIN enrollments e ON c.course_id = e.course_id GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_code, c.course_name ORDER BY enrolled_students DESC, c.course_id ASC;
solution_explanation: Pre-calculates course capacity metrics for registrar pipeline updates.
hints: Use LEFT JOIN to retain courses with zero enrollments.
Focus on the required WHERE, JOIN, or GROUP BY clause conditions.

Query: SELECT c.course_code, c.course_name, COUNT(e.enrollment_id) AS enrolled_students FROM courses c LEFT JOIN enrollments e ON c.course_id = e.course_id GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_code, c.course_name ORDER BY enrolled_students DESC, c.course_id ASC;
